## pp3_Präsi_intern_AK

```{r test}

### label-DF extrahieren
lbl.kat <- ft.label.fnc(vart = "Kategorisch|Mehrfach")
### Variablen extrahieren
kat.gg <- map(lbl.kat, ~ .x %>% select(pp.variable) %>% unlist) %>% 
  unlist %>% 
  as.vector %>% 
  unique

kat.gg <- c(
  "q16",
  "g20_1",
  "g20_2",
  "g20_3",
  # Arbeitszeit
  "q32",
  "q31_ueberstunden",
  # Zufriedenheit
  "q26",
  "q49",
  "q53",
  "cluster_qualitaet_3",
  # Rechte
  "q54_2",
  "q46_SQ010",
  "q34",
  "q23_11",
  # unbezahlte
  # schultyp_rec x q37
  "q37",
  "q38_einkommen_systematik2",
  "g22_",
  "g21_",
  "q17_"
  ) %>% 
  paste0(collapse = "|")
x <- names(pp)[names(pp) %>% str_detect(kat.gg)]
kat.gg <- x[x %>% str_detect("_n$|_other", negate = T)]


### Häufigkeiten
kat.fig <- prep.fig.fnc(pp, kat.gg, out.labs = T, chained.labels = T) %>% 
  compact

kat.fig[[3]] <- kat.fig[[3]] %>% 
  mutate(mc = if_else(var %>% str_detect("g22|g21|g17"), T, F))

### Single == [[1]]

kat.fig.single <- list()
for (i in 1:length(kat.fig[[1]])) {
# for (i in 1) {
   kat.fig.single[[i]] <- fig.fnc(kat.fig[[1]][[i]], x.achse = p, y.achse = label, farbe = f, order.y = T, legends = T, title.wrap = 70, rev.col.scale = T, axis.text = T, title.true = T)
}

### multiple == [[2]]

kat.fig.mult <- list()
for (i in 1:length(kat.fig[[2]])) {
# for (i in 1) {
   kat.fig.mult[[i]] <- fig.fnc(kat.fig[[2]][[i]], x.achse = p, y.achse = label, farbe = f, order.y = T, legends = T, title.wrap = 70, rev.col.scale = T, axis.text = T, title.true = F)
}


### Speichern

     15:17, ~
```

# interessante Syntax

```{r bezahlt}

# var.finder.val.labels.fnc(pp,"bezahlt") %>% 
#   View
var.finder.label.fnc(pp,"bezahl|Bezahl") %>% 
  View
var.finder.label.fnc(pp,"Einkom") %>% 
  View
varnames <- var.finder.label.fnc(pp,"Geld|geld") %>% 
  select(variable) %>% 
  unlist %>% 
  as.vector
varnames <- c(varnames,"q45_6","q38_einkommen_kat")
varnames <- varnames[-which(varnames %in% c("q38_1","q38_2","q38_3","q38_eink_gesamt",
                                            "q38_taschengeld_kat","q38_einkommen_kat","q38_trinkgeld_kat"))] #<- 

labs <- pp %>%
  select(all_of(varnames)) %>%
  get_label %>%
  named.to.df.fnc

labs <- labs %>%
  mutate(frage = label,
         label = ifelse(label %>% str_detect("\\["), 
               label %>% str_extract("(?<=\\[).+(?=\\])"),
               label),
         chained = paste0(name," ", label))

fig.df.1 <- map2_dfr(pp %>%
                       select(varnames),
                   labs$chained, ~ .x %>% 
                     na.omit %>% 
                     fct_count(prop = T) %>% 
                     mutate(var = factor(.y), .before= 1) %>% 
                     mutate(nr = nrow(.)))

fig.df.1 <- fig.df.1 %>%
  mutate(strng = str_extract(var,"^q\\d+|^g\\d+")) %>% 
  group_by(var) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(n),
         var = paste0(var, " (n=",total,")")
         ) %>% 
  ungroup


single <- fig.df.1 %>% 
  filter(strng %in% mult == F)
single.list <- map(single$strng %>% unique, ~ single %>% 
                     filter(strng == .x) %>% 
                     mutate(f = fct_rev(f)))

fig.single <- map(single.list, ~ fig.fnc(.x, x.achse = p, y.achse = var, farbe = f, order.y = T, legends = T), title.wrap = 70)
ggsave(plot=fig.single[[1]], file=paste0(outpath,"/bezahlung-fig-1.png"), device = "png", height = 5, width = 12, units = "in")
ggsave(plot=fig.single[[2]], file=paste0(outpath,"/bezahlung-fig-2.png"), device = "png", height = 4, width = 11, units = "in")
ggsave(plot=fig.single[[3]], file=paste0(outpath,"/bezahlung-fig-3.png"), device = "png", height = 4, width = 10, units = "in")


### Einkommen gesamt
fig <- pp %>% 
  select(q38_einkommen,q38_taschengeld,q38_trinkgeld,q38_eink_gesamt) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>% 
  filter(value < 3000) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y=value, x=name)) + 
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#c45912") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Einkommen gesamt","Einkommen","Taschengeld","Trinkgeld")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.position="bottom",
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(size = 0.3),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank()) #+
  # ggtitle(pp %>% 
  #           select(q38_eink_gesamt) %>% 
  #           get_label)#%>% str_wrap(width = title.wrap))

ggsave(plot=fig, file=paste0(outpath,"/bezahlung-fig-4.png"), device = "png", height = 3, width = 10, units = "in")


### Kreuztabellen

fig <- pp %>% 
  select(schultyp_rec, q37) %>% 
  group_by(schultyp_rec, q37) %>% 
  reframe(n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(schultyp_rec = factor(schultyp_rec, levels = c("Handelsakademie (HAK)",
                                                        "Handelsschule (HAS)",
                                                        "Gewerbliche, technische und kunstgew. Fachschulen",
                                                        "Höhere technische und gewerbliche (einschließlich kunstgewerblicher) Lehranstalten (HTL)",
                                                        "Höhere Lehranstalt für Tourismus (HLT)",
                                                        "Fachschule für wirtschaftliche Berufe",
                                                        "Hotelfachschule, Tourismusfachschule",
                                                        "Höhere Bildungsanstalt für Elementarpädagogik oder Sozialpädagogik",
                                                        "Andere"))) %>% 
  filter(q37 %>% is.na == F) %>% 
  filter(schultyp_rec %>% is.na == F) %>% 
  group_by(schultyp_rec) %>% 
  mutate(perc = n/sum(n)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  fig.fnc(x.achse = perc, y.achse = schultyp_rec, farbe = q37, order.y = T) +
  ggtitle("Haben Sie eine Bezahlung (Einkommen, betriebliches Taschengeld, Trinkgeld) für das Praktikum erhalten?" %>% str_wrap(width = 50))

ggsave(plot=fig, file=paste0(outpath,"/bezahlung-fig-5.png"), device = "png", height = 6, width = 10, units = "in")

```



# Breaks

```{r}

breaks <- pp.alt %>% select(q1, q1_schulform, q1_schultyp, q4, q24, q27, q28, q29, q31_ueberstunden, q36, q40, q51, q53, q55, q57a, q58_notendurchschnitt, q59_sozialer_hintergrund) %>% names()

breaks <- lbl.var.df %>% 
  filter(pp.alt.variable %in% breaks) %>% 
  select(pp.variable) %>% 
  unlist %>% 
  na.omit %>% 
  as.vector

pp %>% 
  select(all_of(breaks)) %>% 
  get_label %>% 
  named.to.df.fnc("Variablenname","Beschriftung") %>% 
  write.xlsx("Breaks.xlsx")


```
